title: Resolution urging DOE to award Civic Readiness seal in all high schools
summary: This resolution calls on the New York City Department of Education to ensure that the New York State Seal of Civic Readiness is awarded to eligible students in all public high schools, not just those that voluntarily apply. It notes that in 2024-2025, 7,855 students from 166 DOE high schools earned the seal, up 72 percent from the prior year, but that the current voluntary application process creates disparities among schools.
